# Letters to a Young Scientist

* April 2, 2013

Letters to a Young Scientist Pulitzer Prize–winning biologist Edward O. Wilson imparts the wisdom of his storied career to the next generation in his new book, [_Letters to a Young Scientist,_](http://books.wwnorton.com/books/detail.aspx?ID=4294972234) published this month by W.W. Norton.

Edward O. Wilson has distilled sixty years of teaching into a book for students, young and old.
